Thanks Marissa —

A couple of clarifying items before I can sign off:
- Can you confirm the expected ramp timeline and first-year quota contribution for this SE?
- What are the specific offsets we can implement if we exceed the band (e.g., deferrals, structured sign-on repayment, staged equity)?
- Is there any precedent from recent SE hires in EMEA/US who were given similar exceptions?

If this is truly tied to an identified $1.1M ARR pipeline and the ramp is <4 months, I’m inclined to approve a controlled exception. I’ll need a short write-up I can forward to Finance — one paragraph on business impact + the proposed guardrails.

Please copy Soojin so recruiting can hold on offer letter language until we confirm approach.

- Aditya
VP, Sales Operations

Subject: Re: SE Offer: Exception for Senior Solutions Engineer (Req 2489)

Aditya —

One-paragraph summary below (also pasted into the Offer_Summary sheet):

Brightline Analytics (strategic target) has executed an LOI contingent on headcount ramp: onboarding the SE by 6/15 unlocks a technical PO and accelerated pilot that converts to $1.1M ARR ARRARR within 9-12 months. The candidate has unique pre-sales experience with Brightline’s tech stack and a signed non-compete waiver; losing the candidate will push the deal to a competitor with a >70% conversion risk. Proposed guardrails: sign-on limited to 10% of base and paid over 6 months; equity grant at band-median with a performance review at 6 months tied to milestone deliverables; if candidate leaves within 9 months, sign-on is repayable on a prorated basis.

Offsets we’ll use: reduce first-year discretionary hiring budget for FY27 by $25k (reallocated from open SDR role), delay equity uplift until Q4 review. We also propose a conditional bonus structure payable on Brightline milestone completion.

Precedent: We extended a similar one-time exception for Req 2173 (EMEA SE) last year — base +10% and sign-on cap; retention rate 92% at 12 months.

Recruiting notes: Soojin, candidate has asked for offer letter today; background and references are cleared. Please hold final template until Aditya/Finance confirm.

— Marissa
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 02 May 2027 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SE Offer: Exception for Senior Solutions Engineer (Req 2489)

Aditya/Marissa —

Thanks for the context and the precedent. Finance reviewed the Offer_Summary and the proposed offsets. I am willing to approve a one-time comp-band exception under the following conditions:

1) Limit base to $165,000 and target OTE to $265,000 as proposed; sign-on limited to 10% of base paid over 6 months with clawback language if the candidate departs within 9 months.
2) Equity grant at current median band; equity uplift to be considered at the Q4 review based on actual contribution to Brightline milestones.
3) A short MOFU (Milestone of Focus) clause: 25% of the sign-on tied to Brightline pilot completion within 90 days.
4) Recruiting to add the repayment clause and milestone language to the offer; Legal to sign off on the clawback verbiage.

I will route the internal approval memo through HR/Finance immediately. Once Legal confirms clawback wording, consider this approved and move to offer.

—Laura
Laura Bennett
SVP, Finance & People Ops
